anomalies.observed: Two ATtiny microcontrollers, U1 (ATtiny13V-10S) and U4 (ATtiny45-20P), are present and every corresponding pin is connected to the same net: pin 1 to NET0012, pin 2 to NET0011, pin 3 to NET0010, pin 4 to GND, pin 5 to NET0001, pin 6 to NET0004, pin 7 to NET0009, and pin 8 to +5V.
anomalies.expected: A fan controller should use one MCU, or if multiple MCUs are intended they should have independent nets. Paralleling two MCU I/O pins creates contention between their push-pull outputs unless exactly one device is populated and the other is explicitly DNP, which is not indicated in the netlist.
anomalies.impact: If both U1 and U4 are populated, their outputs drive the same PWM, I2C/ISP, tach, reset, and power nets simultaneously. This can cause undefined fan control, bus contention, excessive current, and possible damage to one or both MCUs.
